name: Terry Gou
evidence: Last credential: junior-college (五專) diploma in shipping management (航運管理科) from 中國海事專科學校 / China Maritime College, Taipei (today 台北海洋科技大學, Taipei University of Marine Technology), 1971. Chinese-language sources carry the year English ones omit. (1) MBAlib 智库百科, https://wiki.mbalib.com/zh-tw/%E9%83%AD%E5%8F%B0%E9%93%AD , quoted exactly: '郭台銘（Terry Gou）：鴻海精密集團董事長郭台銘，1950年10月8日出生，祖籍山西省澤州縣南嶺鄉葛萬村人。1971臺灣“中國海專”畢業，進入當時中國臺灣省前三大船務公司復興航運工作；1974成立鴻海塑料企業有限公司'. (2) Newton 中文百科全書, https://www.newton.com.tw/wiki/%E9%83%AD%E5%8F%B0%E9%8A%98 , quoted exactly: '1966年郭台銘進入台灣“中國海事專科學校”學習，靠半工半讀完成學業。服完兵役後，郭台銘在復興航運公司當業務員。1971年，台灣“中國海專”畢業'; its infobox gives 畢業院校 (alma mater) as '台灣台北市中國海事專科學校'. (3) Chinese Wikipedia, https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E9%83%AD%E5%8F%B0%E9%8A%98 , independently sources the enrolment year — '1966年考進剛創校的中國海事專科學校' — and lists his education as 板橋國民學校 / 臺北縣立板橋中學 / 中國海事專科學校 航運管理科; a China Times report quoted in that article adds '民國五十四年畢業後再就讀中國海專' (finished the junior-high division in ROC year 54 = 1965, then entered China Maritime College). Enrolment in 1966 plus the standard five-year 五專 programme is consistent with the 1971 completion the two Chinese encyclopaedia sources state outright. English Wikipedia names the institution (Taipei University of Marine Technology, BS) but gives no year. Confidence medium rather than high because the two sources carrying the explicit 1971 are encyclopaedia-style aggregators, not a school register or contemporaneous news report.
